items.title: Only 3 People 🎣 Riddle #8 Answer + Riddle #9: The Clock Tower Trap 🕰️ #shorts

qa.heard: Yesterday, two fathers and two sons caught three fish and each took home one whole fish.  The answer? There were only three people.  A grandfather, his son and his grandson.  The man in the middle is a father and a son at the same time.  Two fathers, two sons, three people, three fish.  Now, a brand new mystery.  An old clock tower strikes six times in exactly five seconds.  Person one stands below and counts every strike.  Each strike is instant and the gaps between them are always equal.  So how long does it take to strike twelve times?  Careful, it is not ten seconds.  Comment your answer.  The answer drops tomorrow at sunrise.
